asset.titleJa: 携帯する草刈り機（刈払機）の外観例
asset.altJa: 長い軸の一端にエンジン、途中に二本の握りと肩掛け用の帯、反対側に円形の金属刃と保護カバーがある、停止した携帯式草刈り機の図。
asset.observationJa: 本体の動力部と刈る部分が長い軸で離れ、手で持つ握りと肩に掛ける帯が付く外観を確認します。この図では一枚の円形金属刃を例として示しています。
asset.limitsJa: 一般的な肩掛け式の外観を示す新規の模式的イラストです。背負い式・モーター式や全機種の形状は表しません。刃の選定・互換性、保護カバーの取付位置や性能、操作・組立・資格・安全手順を判定する図ではありません。チップソーとナイロンコードカッターの比較課題は未完成のままです。

generation.exactPrompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: original equipment appearance illustration for an agriculture-learning app. Create ONE square 2D colored illustration on a plain warm white/ivory background showing a complete generic portable engine-powered brush cutter (Japanese shoulder-carried 草刈り機 / 刈払機), stationary, without a person. Show a long straight slender metal driveshaft, compact engine at the upper/rear end, clearly recognizable bicycle-style handlebar with two hand grips near the middle, a shoulder-harness strap attached near the balance point and hanging naturally, and ONE circular metal grass-cutting blade at the lower/front end with a clearly visible proper protective debris guard behind the cutting head. The circular toothed blade is an example of a chip-saw blade, not a nylon string head. Present the whole assembled machine diagonally across the square with generous margin so engine, shaft, grips, strap, blade, and guard all remain in frame and readable. Clean consistent outlines, restrained colored panels, subtle shading, uncluttered ivory background. Do not use any source photograph or textbook layout; invent a generic independent composition. No person, running blade, motion marks, inset, duplicate machine, disassembled parts, logos, labels, text, numbers, arrows, watermark, or decorative scenery. This is a bounded general-appearance learning example, not assembly or operating instructions.
